name: @proabono/mcp-installation
description: Local MCP server that installs ProAbono into a website, from the developer IDE: hosted pages, rights synchronization, catalogue introspection, customers, subscriptions, usage and invoicing.

scripts.build: npm run refresh:contract && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/vendor-resources.mjs
scripts.test: npm run refresh:contract && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/vendor-resources.mjs build-test/src/resources && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
